title: Compatible horns in simplicial abelian groups admit fillers
statement:
Let $G:\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}	o\mathrm{Ab}$ be a simplicial abelian group, with face homomorphisms $d_i$ and degeneracy homomorphisms $s_i$ [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-object]. For every integer $n\geq1$, every $k\in\{0,\ldots,n\}$, and every family $a_i\in G_{n-1}$ indexed by $0\leq i\leq n$ with $i
e k$, assume, when $n\geq2$, that $d_i a_j=d_{j-1}a_i$ for all $i<j$ with $i,j
e k$. (For $n=1$ there are no compatibility equations.) Then there exists $u\in G_n$ such that $d_i u=a_i$ for every $i
e k$.

from.place: Proof (1)--(2), semistable-alteration input in the nearby-cycle branch: ILO Exposé X, Theorem 3.4, Step 3, invoking Temkin 2010, Theorems 1.5 and 1.1 for a semistable multipointed modification. Temkin proof component: Marked dualizing line bundle and contracted-component degrees. Auxiliary input: Local complete-intersection determinant adjunction underlying the marked dualizing construction, before the marking is inserted. Supporting ring/sheaf input: Functorial standard resolutions and comparison with arbitrary polynomial resolutions. Direct simplicial abelian-group input: termwise surjective quasi-isomorphism has boundary lifting (Stacks 08P1). In the proof of Stacks 08P1, the invocation of the simplicial-group Kan lemma to fill all faces except one (08NZ).
